scope: Closed-cloth opening, upward reveal and fixed-pose harbor menu

requirements.opening: Only the opaque closed curtain is visible: no game title, dragon or prompt.
requirements.reveal: Enter or a tap raises only the cloth. The prepared harbor main menu is behind it.
requirements.input: The opening input is consumed. Menu actions and hit targets are blocked through the reveal and until held confirmation/pointer input is released.
requirements.actor: The menu uses the existing planted greeting/04 sprite, with no body-frame animation.
requirements.visualReference: Actual shipped Brigade menu and character art. The outdated PDF guide is not an acceptance criterion.
requirements.transition: Separate deterministic 54-step cloth reveal, with no gameplay iris or particle transition.

renderingNote: T1 rendering is the V8 lane; --js both compares T0 simulation on V8 and Hermes. These checks are not physical-phone performance measurements.
review: Closed, beginning, middle and fully revealed frames were inspected at both viewports. Front branding/actor/prompt paint is asserted absent; the cloth bottom edge retreats; an underlying Start press is rejected; Options works after the reveal.
